map.多方指数 n 过程的体积功 使用指南: Volume Work of a Polytropic Process User Guide
map.输入初末态压力 P、体积 V 与多方指数 n，计算多方过程的体积功 W，用于气体: Enter the initial and final pressure P, volume V and the polytropic index n to compute the volume work W of the polytropic process, used for estimating process work integrals in any gas compression or expansion.
map.W=(P₂V₂−P₁V₁)/(1−n)（SI 单位）。 n=1 时退化为等温，需: W = (P2*V2 - P1*V1)/(1 - n) in SI units. At n = 1 it degenerates to the isothermal case and the ln form must be used instead.
map.输入初末态压力与体积及多方指数 n，求过程功。: Enter the initial and final pressure and volume with the polytropic index n to get the process work.
map.理想气体多变过程（pV^n=C）体积功。: Volume work of an ideal gas polytropic process (pV^n = C).
map.n=1 等温、n=γ 绝热、n=0 等压的特例。: n = 1 is isothermal, n = gamma adiabatic, n = 0 is the isobaric special case.
map.压缩/膨胀过程能耗估算。: Estimate the energy of a compression or expansion process.
map.：n=1 且 p1v1=p2v2 时 W=0（理想等温闭合）。: When n = 1 and p1*v1 = p2*v2, W = 0 (an ideal isothermal closed cycle).
map.辐射功率（P = ε·σ·A·T⁴）: Radiated Power (P = epsilon * sigma * A * T^4)
map.双层复合壁总热阻与热流: Total Thermal Resistance and Heat Flow of a Double-Layer Composite Wall
map.多变指数，描述热量交换程度；升温压缩 n 介于 1～γ 间。: The polytropic index describes the degree of heat exchange; in heating compression n lies between 1 and gamma.
map.压缩时气体体积减小，外界对气体做功，W 为负。: During compression the gas volume shrinks, the surroundings do work on the gas, and W is negative.
map.→ 打开多方指数 n 过程的体积功工具: -> Open the Polytropic Process Volume Work tool
